notes: μισθώματι → hired dwelling heads on dwelling: the -μα noun's English noun is a real gloss of the lexeme, as rule 66 has it for κτίσμα → created thing. Heading on hired, treating dwelling as a generic completion, remains defensible and the note records it.
πάντας τοὺς εἰσπορευομένους is split rather than compressed: the ASV writes a separate word for the article, so rule 80's whosoever case does not arise and rule 90 gives the article the single that.
εἰσπορευομένους keeps the preverb's in because the following πρός is rendered separately as unto, so nothing competes for it (rule 106).
Anarthrous ἴδιος carries his own with no article competing (rule 47).
